content.value: Let the roll number R is 107001. The sparse polynomial is generated using the digits of (07) [ the roll number: $P ( x ) = C _ { k } . x ^ { k } + C _ { k - 1 } . x ^ { k - 1 } + \cdots + C _ { 1 } . x + C$ , where k = highest power of x, derived from the sum of the digits of R modulo 5, plus 3 (to ensure a minimum degree of 3) = (sum of digits of R mod 3). Coefficient Ci = Alternating digits of the roll number, starting from the least significant digit.
Using Horner's method, evaluate the sparse polynomial P(x) at $x = 2$ , simplifying the computation by identifying and skipping terms with zero coefficients (sparse polynomial optimization).
